description: A total numerical function of two variables is total recursive under the finite-vector closure rules if and only if its curried form satisfies the binary library predicate \(\operatorname{Computable}_2\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.RecursiveFunctionConventions.binary_total_recursive_iff {f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.TotalRecursive
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.lift fun v =>
        f (List.Vector.get v 0) (List.Vector.get v 1)) ↔
    Computable₂ f
